ia_school_immunization.name: Iowa School and Child Care Immunization Audit
ia_school_immunization.organization: Iowa Department of Health and Human Services
ia_school_immunization.description: County-level K-12 EXEMPTION data from the annual Iowa HHS school and child-care audit reports. Medical and religious certificates are published in separate files, each with a certificate count and the audited enrolment. RATES ARE COMPUTED FROM THE COUNTS, not read from the published percentage column. Iowa's medical-exemption rates are all below 1 percent, which used to defeat a scale check and get the whole file multiplied by 100 -- Dickinson County 2020-21, with 27 medical certificates against 2,707 enrolled, shipped as 100 percent instead of 1.0 percent. Dividing the certificate count by the audited enrolment removes the question of scale entirely. rate_full_exempt is the combined certificate count over the same denominator, rather than the sum of the two component rates, because the two files are joined on enrolment and can disagree about a county's audited total.
ia_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.
